index.html.heading: Compare scope before choosing a tax strategist
index.html.body:
Start with firm profiles, use the shortlist tool, and work through the hiring guides. Ask about relevant experience, deliverables, implementation responsibilities, fees and who will prepare your returns.

Read the directory methodology and verify current credentials and service availability directly. This directory is published by AE Tax Advisors; review its firm profile and compare alternatives using the same questions.
